articles.title_en: Identification and estimation of spillover effects in randomized experiments
articles.title_cn: 随机实验中溢出效应的识别与估计
articles.abstract_en: I study identification, estimation and inference for spillover effects in experiments where units’ outcomes may depend on the treatment assignments of other units within a group. I show that the commonly-used reduced-form linear-in-means regression identifies a weighted sum of spillover effects with some negative weights, and that the difference in means between treated and controls identifies a combination of direct and spillover effects entering with different signs. I propose nonparametric estimators for average direct and spillover effects that overcome these issues and are consistent and asymptotically normal under a precise relationship between the number of parameters of interest, the total sample size and the treatment assignment mechanism. These findings are illustrated using data from a conditional cash transfer program and with simulations. The empirical results reveal the potential pitfalls of failing to flexibly account for spillover effects in policy evaluation: the estimated difference in means and the reduced-form linear-in-means coefficients are all close to zero and statistically insignificant, whereas the nonparametric estimators I propose reveal large, nonlinear and significant spillover effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了在实验中溢出效应的识别、估计和推断，其中单位的结果可能依赖于组内其他单位的处理分配。我表明，常用的简化形式线性均值回归识别的是具有一些负权重的溢出效应的加权和，而处理组和对照组之间的均值差异识别的是直接效应和溢出效应以不同符号进入的组合。我提出了平均直接效应和溢出效应的非参数估计器，这些估计器克服了这些问题，并在感兴趣参数的数量、总样本量和处理分配机制之间的精确关系下具有一致性和渐近正态性。这些发现通过有条件现金转移计划的数据和模拟进行了说明。实证结果揭示了在政策评估中未能灵活考虑溢出效应的潜在陷阱：估计的均值差异和简化形式线性均值系数都接近于零且统计上不显著，而我提出的非参数估计器揭示了大型、非线性和显著的溢出效应。

articles.title_en: Identification of mixtures of dynamic discrete choices
articles.title_cn: 动态离散选择混合模型的识别
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides new identification results for finite mixtures of Markov processes. Our arguments yield identification from knowledge of the cross-sectional distribution of three (or more) effective time-series observations under simple conditions. We explain how our approach and results are different from those in previous work by Kasahara and Shimotsu (2009) and Hu and Shum (2012). Most notably, outside information, such as monotonicity restrictions that link conditional distributions to latent types, is not needed.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为马尔可夫过程的有限混合提供了新的识别结果。我们的论证表明，在简单条件下，仅凭三个（或更多）有效时间序列观测的横截面分布即可实现识别。我们解释了我们的方法与结果为何不同于Kasahara和Shimotsu（2009）以及Hu和Shum（2012）的先前工作。尤为重要的是，我们不需要外部信息，例如将条件分布与潜在类型联系起来的单调性限制。

articles.title_en: Under-identification of structural models based on timing and information set assumptions
articles.title_cn: 基于时机与信息集假设的结构模型识别不足
articles.abstract_en: We revisit identification based on timing and information set assumptions in structural models, which have been used in the context of production functions, demand equations, and hedonic pricing models (e.g. Olley and Pakes, 1996, Blundell and Bond, 2000). First, we demonstrate a general under-identification problem using these assumptions in a simple version of the Blundell–Bond dynamic panel model. In particular, the basic moment conditions can yield multiple discrete solutions: one at the persistence parameter in the main equation and another at the persistence parameter governing the regressor. We then propose a possible solution in the simple setting by enforcing an assumed sign restriction and discuss more general practical advice for empirical researchers using these methods.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们重新审视了结构模型中基于时机与信息集假设的识别问题，这些假设已被用于生产函数、需求方程和特征价格模型（例如Olley和Pakes，1996；Blundell和Bond，2000）。首先，我们在Blundell–Bond动态面板模型的一个简单版本中，证明了使用这些假设时存在普遍的识别不足问题。特别是，基本矩条件可能产生多个离散解：一个位于主方程中的持续性参数处，另一个位于控制回归元的持续性参数处。然后，我们通过在简单设定中强制施加一个假设的符号限制，提出了一种可能的解决方案，并为使用这些方法的实证研究者讨论了更一般的实用建议。

articles.title_en: Inference under covariate-adaptive randomization with imperfect compliance
articles.title_cn: 协变量自适应随机化与不完全依从下的推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies inference in a randomized controlled trial (RCT) with covariate-adaptive randomization (CAR) and imperfect compliance of a binary treatment. In this context, we study inference on the local average treatment effect (LATE), i.e., the average treatment effect conditional on individuals that always comply with the assigned treatment. As in Bugni et al. (2018, 2019), CAR refers to randomization schemes that first stratify according to baseline covariates and then assign treatment status so as to achieve “balance” within each stratum. In contrast to these papers, however, we allow participants of the RCT to endogenously decide to comply or not with the assigned treatment status.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究在协变量自适应随机化（CAR）和二元处理不完全依从的随机对照试验（RCT）中的推断。在此背景下，我们研究局部平均处理效应（LATE）的推断，即对始终依从分配处理的个体的平均处理效应。如Bugni等人（2018，2019）所述，CAR指首先根据基线协变量分层，然后在每层内分配处理状态以实现“平衡”的随机化方案。然而，与这些论文不同，我们允许RCT参与者内生决定是否依从分配的处理状态。

articles.title_en: Linear panel regressions with two-way unobserved heterogeneity
articles.title_cn: 具有双向不可观测异质性的线性面板回归
articles.abstract_en: We study linear panel regression models in which the unobserved error term is an unknown smooth function of two-way unobserved fixed effects. In standard additive or interactive fixed effect models the individual specific and time specific effects are assumed to enter with a known functional form (additive or multiplicative). In this paper, we allow for this functional form to be more general and unknown. We discuss two different estimation approaches that allow consistent estimation of the regression parameters in this setting as the number of individuals and the number of time periods grow to infinity. The first approach uses the interactive fixed effect estimator in Bai (2009), which is still applicable here, as long as the number of factors in the estimation grows asymptotically. The second approach first discretizes the two-way unobserved heterogeneity (similar to what Bonhomme et al., 2021 are doing for one-way heterogeneity) and then estimates a simple linear fixed effect model with additive two-way grouped fixed effects. For both estimation methods we obtain asymptotic convergence results, perform Monte Carlo simulations, and employ the estimators in an empirical application to UK house price data.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究线性面板回归模型，其中不可观测的误差项是双向不可观测固定效应的未知平滑函数。在标准的加性或交互固定效应模型中，个体特定和时间特定效应被假定以已知的函数形式（加性或乘性）进入。在本文中，我们允许这种函数形式更一般且未知。我们讨论了两种不同的估计方法，当个体数量和时间期数趋于无穷时，这些方法能够一致地估计该设定下的回归参数。第一种方法使用Bai（2009）中的交互固定效应估计量，只要估计中的因子数量渐近增长，该方法在此仍然适用。第二种方法首先将双向不可观测异质性离散化（类似于Bonhomme等人，2021对单向异质性所做的），然后估计一个具有加性双向分组固定效应的简单线性固定效应模型。对于这两种估计方法，我们获得了渐近收敛结果，进行了蒙特卡洛模拟，并将估计量应用于英国房价数据的实证分析中。

articles.title_en: Stable outcomes and information in games: An empirical framework
articles.title_cn: 博弈中的稳定结果与信息：一个实证框架
articles.abstract_en: Empirically, many strategic settings are characterized by stable outcomes in which players’ decisions are publicly observed, yet no player takes the opportunity to deviate. To analyze such situations in the presence of incomplete information, we build an empirical framework by introducing a novel solution concept that we call Bayes stable equilibrium and computationally tractable approaches for estimation and inference. Our framework allows the researcher to be agnostic about players’ information and the equilibrium selection rule. In an application, we study the strategic entry decisions of McDonald’s and Burger King in the US. While the Bayes stable equilibrium identified set is always (weakly) tighter than the Bayes correlated equilibrium identified set, our results show that the former can be substantially tighter in practice. In a counterfactual experiment, we examine the impact of increasing access to healthy food on the market structures in Mississippi food deserts.
articles.abstract_cn: 在实证中，许多战略环境以稳定结果为特征，其中参与者的决策被公开观察，但没有任何参与者利用机会偏离。为了在信息不完全的情况下分析此类情形，我们通过引入一种我们称之为贝叶斯稳定均衡的新解概念以及计算上可行的估计与推断方法，构建了一个实证框架。我们的框架允许研究者对参与者的信息和均衡选择规则保持不可知态度。在一项应用中，我们研究了麦当劳和汉堡王在美国的战略进入决策。虽然贝叶斯稳定均衡识别集总是（弱）紧于贝叶斯相关均衡识别集，但我们的结果表明前者在实践中可能显著更紧。在一项反事实实验中，我们考察了增加健康食品获取对密西西比州食物荒漠中市场结构的影响。

articles.title_cn: 穿透零星回报可预测性
articles.abstract_en: Return predictability has been one of the central research questions in finance for many decades. This paper proposes a predictive regression with multiple structural changes to capture the sporadic predictive ability of potential predictors for the return series. An adaptive group Lasso procedure, augmented with a forward regression for break screening, is adopted to efficiently and consistently identify the structural breaks in the predictive regression, with predictors exhibiting low signal strength and heterogeneous degrees of persistence. To enhance the prediction accuracy, adaptive Lasso is further used to eliminate the irrelevant predictors and is shown to achieve the oracle property. Simulation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed methods in break detection and predictor selection, and further show that ignoring structural breaks could abate predictability. The application to predicting U.S. equity premium illustrates the practical merits of our methodology in revealing return predictability that changes over time.
articles.abstract_cn: 回报可预测性几十年来一直是金融领域的核心研究问题之一。本文提出了一种带有多个结构性变化的预测回归模型，以捕捉潜在预测因子对回报序列的零星预测能力。采用自适应组Lasso程序，并辅以前向回归进行断点筛选，以高效且一致地识别预测回归中的结构性断点，其中预测因子具有低信号强度和异质性的持久性程度。为提高预测精度，进一步使用自适应Lasso消除不相关的预测因子，并证明其达到预言性质。模拟研究展示了所提方法在断点检测和预测因子选择方面的有效性，并进一步表明忽略结构性断点会削弱可预测性。应用于预测美国股票溢价的实例说明了我们的方法在揭示随时间变化的回报可预测性方面的实际价值。

articles.title_en: A new generalized exponentially weighted moving average quantile model and its statistical inference
articles.title_cn: 一种新的广义指数加权移动平均分位数模型及其统计推断
articles.abstract_en: The exponentially weighting scheme is a simple and pragmatic approach to compute the value at risk (VaR). However, the existing exponentially weighting methods lack a sound statistical inference procedure. To circumvent this deficiency, this paper proposes a new generalized exponentially weighted moving average (GEWMA) quantile model, which allows a much broader weighting scheme than the benchmark one used in “Risk Metrics” document. For the GEWMA quantile model, a systematic statistical inference procedure is provided, including the weighted estimators for the weighting parameters, a t-test for the stability of the conditional quantile, another t-test for the mean invariance of the conditional quantile, a unit root test for the absence of intercept term, and several dynamic quantile tests for the model checking. Under mild conditions, the asymptotics of all proposed estimators and tests are established. Simulations show that all proposed estimators and tests have good finite-sample performances. Applications to four major exchange rates demonstrate that the weighting scheme suggested by “Risk Metrics” document is inappropriate, and the GEWMA quantile model delivers better VaR predictions than its many competitive methods. As an extension, the asymmetric GEWMA quantile model is also studied.
articles.abstract_cn: 指数加权方案是一种计算风险价值（VaR）的简单且实用的方法。然而，现有的指数加权方法缺乏健全的统计推断程序。为克服这一缺陷，本文提出了一种新的广义指数加权移动平均（GEWMA）分位数模型，该模型允许比“Risk Metrics”文档中使用的基准方案更广泛的加权方案。针对GEWMA分位数模型，提供了系统的统计推断程序，包括加权参数的加权估计量、条件分位数稳定性的t检验、条件分位数均值不变性的另一个t检验、无截距项的单位根检验，以及用于模型检验的多个动态分位数检验。在温和条件下，建立了所有提出的估计量和检验的渐近性质。模拟表明，所有提出的估计量和检验均具有良好的有限样本性能。对四种主要汇率的应用表明，“Risk Metrics”文档建议的加权方案不适用，GEWMA分位数模型比许多竞争方法提供了更好的VaR预测。作为扩展，还研究了非对称GEWMA分位数模型。

articles.title_en: Estimation and inference in a high-dimensional semiparametric Gaussian copula vector autoregressive model
articles.title_cn: 高维半参数高斯连接函数向量自回归模型的估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops simple, robust estimation and inference methods for the transition matrix of a high-dimensional semiparametric Gaussian copula vector autoregressive process. Our estimator is based on rank estimators of the large variance and auto-covariance matrices of a transformed latent high-dimensional Gaussian process. We derive rates of convergence of our estimator based on which we develop de-biased inference for Granger causality. Numerical results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed methods. Although our focus is on the observable process, by the nature of rank estimators, all the methods developed directly apply to the transformed latent process. In technical terms, our analysis relies heavily on newly developed exponential inequalities for (degenerate) U-statistics under α-mixing condition.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为高维半参数高斯连接函数向量自回归过程的转移矩阵开发了简单且稳健的估计与推断方法。我们的估计量基于对变换后的潜在高维高斯过程的大方差和自协方差矩阵的秩估计。我们推导了估计量的收敛速度，并在此基础上发展了针对格兰杰因果性的去偏推断。数值结果证明了所提出方法的有效性。尽管我们关注的是可观测过程，但由于秩估计的性质，所有开发的方法直接适用于变换后的潜在过程。在技术层面，我们的分析在很大程度上依赖于在α混合条件下新开发的（退化）U统计量的指数不等式。

articles.title_en: Adaptive robust large volatility matrix estimation based on high-frequency financial data
articles.title_cn: 基于高频金融数据的自适应稳健大波动率矩阵估计
articles.abstract_en: Several novel statistical methods have been developed to estimate large integrated volatility matrices based on high-frequency financial data. To investigate their asymptotic behaviors, they require a sub-Gaussian or finite high-order moment assumption for observed log-returns, which cannot account for the heavy-tail phenomenon of stock-returns. Recently, a robust estimator was developed to handle heavy-tailed distributions with some bounded fourth-moment assumption. However, we often observe that log-returns have heavier tail distribution than the finite fourth-moment and that the degrees of heaviness of tails are heterogeneous across asset and over time. In this paper, to deal with the heterogeneous heavy-tailed distributions, we develop an adaptive robust integrated volatility estimator that employs pre-averaging and truncation schemes based on jump-diffusion processes. We call this an adaptive robust pre-averaging realized volatility (ARP) estimator. We show that the ARP estimator has a sub-Weibull tail concentration with only finite 2α-th moments for any α>1. In addition, we establish matching upper and lower bounds to show that the ARP estimation procedure is optimal. To estimate large integrated volatility matrices using the approximate factor model, the ARP estimator is further regularized using the principal orthogonal complement thresholding (POET) method. The numerical study is conducted to check the finite sample performance of the ARP estimator.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于高频金融数据，已有多种新颖的统计方法被开发用于估计大积分波动率矩阵。为研究其渐近行为，这些方法要求观测到的对数收益率满足次高斯或有限高阶矩假设，这无法解释股票收益率的重尾现象。近期，有学者开发了一种稳健估计量来处理具有有界四阶矩假设的重尾分布。然而，我们经常观察到对数收益率的尾部分布比有限四阶矩更重，且尾部的重尾程度在不同资产和不同时间上是异质的。在本文中，为处理异质重尾分布，我们开发了一种自适应稳健积分波动率估计量，该估计量基于跳跃扩散过程采用预平均和截断方案。我们称之为自适应稳健预平均已实现波动率（ARP）估计量。我们证明，在仅具有有限2α阶矩（对任意α>1）的条件下，ARP估计量具有次韦伯尾部集中性。此外，我们建立了匹配的上下界，以表明ARP估计程序是最优的。为使用近似因子模型估计大积分波动率矩阵，进一步采用主正交补阈值（POET）方法对ARP估计量进行正则化。我们进行了数值研究，以检验ARP估计量的有限样本性能。

articles.title_en: Identification of dynamic binary response models
articles.title_cn: 动态二元响应模型的识别
articles.abstract_en: We consider identification of parameters in dynamic binary response models with panel data under minimal assumptions. This model is prominent in empirical economics as it has been used to infer state dependence in the presence of unobserved heterogeneity. The main results in our paper are characterizations of the identified set under weak assumptions. The results generalize the existing literature in several directions: (1) we do not require any restrictions on the support of the observables; for example, we allow for time trends, time dummies, and/or only discrete covariates; (2) we only maintain that the idiosyncratic error terms are stationary over time conditional on the fixed effect and the covariates (without conditioning on initial conditions) and without imposing a parametric distribution on the distribution of these error terms; (3) we show that it is possible to get point identification in some cases even with T=2 (two time periods). We also construct examples of identified sets in some designs to illustrate the informational content of different assumptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑在最小假设下，利用面板数据识别动态二元响应模型中的参数。该模型在实证经济学中具有重要地位，因为它被用于在存在不可观测异质性的情况下推断状态依赖性。我们论文的主要结果是在弱假设下对识别集的刻画。这些结果在几个方向上推广了现有文献：（1）我们不对可观测变量的支撑集施加任何限制；例如，我们允许时间趋势、时间虚拟变量和/或仅离散协变量；（2）我们仅保持 idiosyncratic 误差项在给定固定效应和协变量的条件下随时间平稳（不依赖于初始条件），并且不对这些误差项的分布施加参数分布；（3）我们表明，即使 T=2（两个时期），在某些情况下也有可能获得点识别。我们还构建了一些设计中的识别集示例，以说明不同假设的信息内容。

articles.abstract_en: In statistics, the standard error has a clear technical definition: it is the estimated standard deviation of a parameter estimate. In practice, though, challenges arise when we go beyond the simple balls-in-urn model to consider generalizations beyond the population from which the data were sampled. This is important because generalization is nearly always the goal of quantitative studies. In this brief paper we consider three examples.
articles.abstract_cn: 在统计学中，标准误有一个明确的技术定义：它是参数估计的估计标准差。然而，在实践中，当我们超越简单的瓮中取球模型，考虑对数据抽样总体之外的推广时，挑战就会出现。这一点很重要，因为推广几乎总是定量研究的目标。在这篇简短的论文中，我们考虑三个例子。

articles.title_en: Econometric inference on a large Bayesian game with heterogeneous beliefs
articles.title_cn: 异质信念下大型贝叶斯博弈的计量推断
articles.abstract_en: Econometric models of strategic interactions among people or firms have received a great deal of attention in the literature. Less attention has been paid to the role of the underlying assumptions about the way agents form beliefs about other agents. We focus on a single large Bayesian game with idiosyncratic strategic neighborhoods and develop an approach of empirical modeling that relaxes the assumption of rational expectations and allows the players to form beliefs differently. By drawing on the main intuition of Kalai (2004), we introduce the notion of hindsight regret, which measures each player’s ex-post value of other players’ type information, and obtain the belief-free bound for the hindsight regret. Using this bound, we derive testable implications and develop a bootstrap inference procedure for the structural parameters. Our inference method is uniformly valid regardless of the size of strategic neighborhoods and tends to exhibit high power when the neighborhoods are large. We demonstrate the finite sample performance of the method through Monte Carlo simulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于人或企业之间战略互动的计量经济模型在文献中受到了广泛关注。然而，对于代理人如何形成对其他代理人信念的潜在假设所起的作用，关注较少。我们聚焦于一个具有异质性战略邻域的单一大型贝叶斯博弈，并发展了一种实证建模方法，该方法放宽了理性预期的假设，允许参与者以不同方式形成信念。借鉴Kalai（2004）的主要直觉，我们引入了事后遗憾的概念，该概念衡量每个参与者在事后对其他参与者类型信息的价值，并获得了事后遗憾的无信念界限。利用这一界限，我们推导出可检验的隐含条件，并开发了结构参数的自举推断程序。我们的推断方法在战略邻域大小上具有一致有效性，并且在邻域较大时往往表现出较高的功效。我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟展示了该方法的有限样本性能。

articles.title_en: What is uncertainty in today’s practice of data science?
